title: OI-Bench: An Option Injection Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Susceptibility to Directive Interference
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark (OI-Bench) to evaluate how directive interference, such as social cues or instructional framing, affects LLM decision-making in multiple-choice questions. While it uses categories like 'social compliance' as attack vectors, its primary objective is robustness evaluation rather than benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics.
